data.math_review: After acc=(s0+s1)+(s2+s3), let a_j=acc_j+acc_(j+4). Original HADD returns (a0+a1)+(a2+a3). Shuffle/add forms lanes [a0+a1,a1+a0,a2+a3,a3+a2]; final low add returns lane0+lane2 with identical operand order. No reassociation of contributing operations.
data.oracle: Independent finite half conversion via exact powers of two; signed bytes decoded arithmetically; separate float weight multiplication, std::fma in four scalar lane chains, explicit original addition tree with volatile rounding. Same compiler control/candidate coexist in separate namespaces. Access-only headers expose existing CPU flags.

data.scope: Read-only source review of run-numerical.py, forced.cpp and ppl.cpp; small-file verification of prior prompt-token alignment and terminal numerical report. No tests, model reads or timings performed by this review.
findings: Control runs twice, then candidate. Every one of the 33 vectors is finite, has 151936 float32 elements, and both repeat/candidate bytes must equal control0 bytes.

All four serial NLL cases compare exact parsed values from 17-significant-digit output against control0; each arm independently satisfies existing HF continuous 0.01 or window 0.02 absolute mean-NLL bounds.
Forced continuation scoring is aligned: prefill logits score target0; step00 logits score target1. Final step31 vector is included in byte identity but is not used to score a nonexistent target32.
Both continuation IDs and serial excerpt IDs are checked against the respective HF reference inputs.

The runner itself asserts only the 1943-token prefix length, not the complete prefix-ID list. The exact current prompt and HF prefix IDs match the prior committed independent tokenizer-alignment evidence recorded below; tokenizer implementation is outside this reduction-only change.
Long coverage is 1943 prefix tokens plus 32 forced tokens at ubatch128. This is not a maximum-context or full-corpus claim.
